analysis.summary: Sacheerome Limited presented its investor presentation for H2 FY26 and FY26, reporting total revenue of ₹15,238.58 Lakhs and EBITDA of ₹4,066.15 Lakhs for FY26. Management highlighted sustained growth across fragrances and flavours driven by strong demand in FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories. To support growth, the company is constructing a new manufacturing unit in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh, with land acquired and machinery ordered. In addition, Sacheerome is expanding its R&D and sales footprint to target the Middle East and GCC markets. Sacheerome Limited hosted its earnings call for H1 FY26 following its listing on the NSE Emerge platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects performance in the second half of the year to match or slightly exceed H1 FY26 results.
guidance.quote: So, we are doing equally good and we hope to perform as good as the first half or even a little better.

guidance.claim: Revenue generation from the new facility is expected to commence in Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also.

demand_outlook.claim: The fragrance and flavour industry is seeing strong demand driven by growing consumption in FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care.
demand_outlook.quote: The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong performance in H1 FY26 was supported by healthy demand across product categories and an expanded product range.
demand_outlook.quote: We delivered a strong performance, driven by healthy demand across different product categories, and with the enhanced product range.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic market served as the main growth driver, contributing Rs. 25.52 crores to the revenue increase.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic market continue to be the key growth engine, contributing Rs.25.52 crores of the overall increase.

capex_expansion.claim: The total investment for the new YEIDA facility is approximately Rs. 184.16 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total facility is approximately Rs.184.16 crores and we are going on the track and we are making the good progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company remains on schedule to bring the YEIDA facility into full operations in Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility is located on 21,023 square meters of land and consists of two main towers.
capex_expansion.quote: This facility is being built on a land area of 21,023 sq. mtrs. and will comprise of two towers, with one tower dedicated to fragrances and the other two flavors.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that superior margin expansion alongside revenue growth demonstrates business model and execution strength.
margins_costs.quote: Our ability to deliver superior margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth reflects the strength of our business model, product portfolio, and execution capabilities.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased to 26.98% in H1 FY26 from 20.22% in the prior year period due to operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 26.98% from 20.22% in the same period last year, reflecting improved operating leverage and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity is 760,000 kilos, and the expansion will add 2,000,000 kilos, raising total capacity to 2,760,000 kilos.
orders_capacity.quote: So, as you are aware, our current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos and in the new capacity, we are doing adding another 20 lakh kilos which will make our total capacity to 27,60,000 kilos.

capital_allocation.claim: Management highlighted a strengthened balance sheet and healthy cash flows to sustain long-term profitable growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With our strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and scalable operating platform, we remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long -term profitable growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains minimal debt levels and well-managed liquidity.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt levels remain minimal, indicating financial stability, while liquidity is well-managed.

capital_allocation.claim: As of H1 FY26, Rs. 53.64 crores has been invested into the YEIDA facility using IPO proceeds and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As on first half of FY26, we have invested Rs.53.64 crores of funds into the YEIDA facility.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reduced its working capital cycle to approximately 23 days from 45 days in the prior year.
capital_allocation.quote: One of the examples could be how we were able to optimize our working capital cycle as well which we have been able to operate at about 23-days compared to 45-days which we were doing in previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business performance could be impacted by general market, macroeconomic, regulatory, currency exchange, and competitive factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of third parties dealing with us, legislative developments, and other key factors that could affect our business and financial performance .

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited past supply and industry disruptions including a fire at BASF, COVID-19, Chinese products, and weather-driven shortages.
risks_headwinds.quote: First of all, there was a fire in BSF, then there was COVID, then, China products, and sometimes, due to the climatic conditions, due to some reasons, there is scarcity.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to bring the upcoming YEIDA facility into full operations in Q4 FY26.
management_commitments.quote: We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from the new manufacturing plant will start coming from Q1 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also.
